panels.title: 실시간 BrainOn Service Logs · Loki
panels.description: Backend · Celery · RabbitMQ · Prometheus · Loki · Grafana 등 주요 서비스의 실시간 로그입니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*)::bigint
        AS "INTERNAL_INCIDENTS_1H"

FROM audit_auditlog

WHERE
    occurred_at
    >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

    AND COALESCE(
        outcome,
        'UNKNOWN'
    ) NOT IN (
        'SUCCESS',
        'SUCCEEDED',
        'COMPLETED',
        'OK'
    )
